::: {.card-block}
### Hi, I'm Christiana 👋

I'm a Postdoctoral Research Scholar in the Department of Earth and
Environmental Sciences at Michigan State University. I study how the
atmosphere, land surface, and terrestrial biosphere interact as a coupled
system — and how that coupling shapes risk to agriculture, water resources,
and ecosystems as the climate changes. I work across regional-to-continental
Earth system models (RegCM4, WRF, WRF-Hydro, CLM), CMIP6/CORDEX-CORE
ensembles, and machine learning, with a geographic focus spanning West Africa
and the continental United States.

[Read more about my research →](about.qmd)
:::

## What I'm working on

::: {.card-block}
### Vegetation–climate coupling & compound extremes
Building an independent research program connecting mechanistic Earth system
modeling to concrete consequences for food systems, water resources, and
ecosystem resilience.

<span class="pill">CMIP6</span><span class="pill">CORDEX-CORE</span><span class="pill">Machine Learning</span>
:::

::: {.card-block}
### Olusegun Python Toolkit
An offline, plug-and-play Python/Jupyter/ML environment (pandas, NumPy,
PyTorch, TensorFlow, and more) built so members of the ASCENDE Network with
limited internet access can complete climate-relevant coding exercises.

<span class="pill">Python</span><span class="pill">Open Source</span><span class="pill">Offline-first</span>

[View on GitHub →](https://github.com/chrystali2002/Olusegun-Python-Toolkit)
:::

::: {.card-block}
### ASCENDE Network
A global, women-centered mentorship community connecting early-career climate
scientists across Africa, Europe, and North America through monthly virtual
hangouts.

<span class="pill">Community</span><span class="pill">Mentorship</span>

[Visit the site →](https://chrystali2002.github.io/ascende-network)
:::
